title: REQ · App loads the current round with loading and error state and passes it to the header
summary: App wires real round fetch into HeaderOverlay
description: Context: App swallows getCurrentRound errors and shows 'Round unavailable'. Desired behavior: App tracks loading/error, builds an error message from the failure, and renders HeaderOverlay via GameLayout's header slot instead of loose RoundBadge/Countdown. Why: no unexplained failures.
acceptance_criteria: Given getCurrentRound resolves, when App is playing, then header shows round id and status
Given getCurrentRound rejects, when App is playing, then header shows an alert containing 'Round status unavailable' and the failure reason
Given getCurrentRound is pending, when App is playing, then 'Loading round…' is shown

preserve: Suggest What Happens Next button and ContributionSheet

definition_of_done: App renders header in all three states
